How It Works

Our Streamlined Process

Switching to our medical billing services is a straightforward process. No disruption to your day-to-day clinical operations and cash flow.

01020304 Step 1 of 4
01 · Step 1 of 4

Comprehensive Practice Audit

We begin by reviewing your current billing processes, identifying past revenue leaks, and finding immediate opportunities to improve your practice’s profitability.

02 · Step 2 of 4

Effortless Onboarding

There are no complicated software integrations required. We securely log into the billing systems you already use, ensuring your daily clinical routines remain completely unchanged.

03 · Step 3 of 4

Execution & Claim Optimization

Our certified professionals handle your daily billing, coding and claim submissions. We guarantee compliance and accuracy to expedite reimbursements.

04 · Step 4 of 4

Reporting & Revenue Growth

Complete transparency with monthly financial reports. We are tracking your critical metrics to make sure that your practice revenue is growing.
